acceptance_gate: A proves the gate audit with checks on every census law composing like cycles (composites, hubs, recodings, restrictions, pinning failures, transport failures); B proves the route, metric, separation, non-recovery and non-selection statements with checks on random systems, chains, the triangle network and representable matroids.
objective: Serves the contact, network and distance questions of docs/FOUNDATIONAL_THESIS.md and docs/COMMON_VERBIAGE.md (contact network, path, native route, native separation, minimal contact-distance) and open question 9 of docs/KNOT_INTUITION.md. The owner approved, after LOOP-HOMOLOGY-20261021-001: check whether two knots sharing one distinction, in a law that composes like cycles, pass every native-network gate; then ask whether the law's own matroids fix adjacency, paths and separation without a hand-drawn layout. Scoping found: two such knots compose, by forgetting the shared distinction, into one knot on all their other distinctions in every census law; routes of contacts compose into single contacts, so path length survives only as bond size, and bond size minus one satisfies the triangle inequality on every sampled system but fails on a NAND hub; forgetting a chain's shared distinctions composes its ends while pinning one separates them; a triangle of parity contacts has the matroid of K4, whose symmetries exchange drawn contacts with the loop's hole; and the parity law realizes the Fano plane, so the law fixes no graph. A audits the gates; B constructs adjacency, routes, separation and a candidate bond distance from allowed states, and tests what the drawing and the law do and do not fix.
status: Complete 2026-10-21. Two knots sharing one distinction in a law composing like cycles pass the contact-network gate under recodings, erasure, restriction by the law's own relations, isomorphisms and pp-definitions: forgetting the shared distinction composes them into one knot on all their other distinctions, with nothing lost, nothing tied and no hub. Pinning keeps the verdict exactly when the law with constants still composes like cycles (affine laws, then tractable; not parity beside J or K4); homomorphic equivalence and products are not admissible transports; S3's passing pairs show that pairs do not certify a law. In a declared substrate the allowed states fix contact adjacency, routes (which compose into single contacts), native separation (forgetting a shared distinction composes, fixing it cuts; reversed for private loops) and an extended bond distance growing by one per atom, all failing in a hub. They do not recover the drawing (the triangle of parity contacts has the matroid of K4), and the law fixes no substrate (Fano in parity, U(2,4) in the Z3 3-net). Next (owner's choice): substrates formed rather than declared (1/3), banking (2/3), or Urquhart (1/3).
stop_rule: One bounded epic: the gate audit and one adjacency study. If every adjacency comes from the layout, record that as the obstruction and stop.
